description: Source to running container: real build, registry digest, SBOM, scan, signature, approval, Ansible deploy, health check and rollback.

assertions.assertion: the netCI API is healthy
netCI is backed by a database, not process memory
v1: the registry returned an immutable digest
v1: Syft produced a CycloneDX SBOM
v1: Cosign verifies the published image against the signing key
v2: the registry returned an immutable digest
v2: Syft produced a CycloneDX SBOM
v2: Cosign verifies the published image against the signing key
two builds of different source produce two different digests
a new run starts queued
replaying the same idempotency key returns the same run
the v1 artifact satisfies the supply-chain policy
a production deployment waits for approval
the pipeline waits for approval too
approval moves the deployment to deploying
approval is attributed to the authenticated caller
the deployed service reports healthy
the running service reports the digest that was approved
the pipeline completes once the deployment is healthy
the promoted release runs the second digest
netCI records the rollback
the rollback keeps the superseded digest for audit
the service is serving the rolled-back digest again
a commit event was recorded for each run
each production deployment produced a deployment event
DORA is projected from the events this gate produced
deployment frequency is non-zero after two releases
